paragraphs: Rav Amram, son of R' Shimon bar Abba.
He reported in his father’s name in Shabbat 119b, and in R' Chanina’s name in Sanhedrin 70a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: קיט: and ע. give Shabbat 119b and Sanhedrin 70a under the colon/period convention, without independently checked named editions. The source כשבת/כסנהדרין is read contextually in/as in, with Hebrew unchanged.

Amram has full Rav; both Shimon and Chanina remain R'. Catalog דרבי does not expand supplied דר׳. Reporting in his father’s name and separately Chanina’s name remains at source force, without identity binding.
